_comment: Security baseline of the development image 0.0.61, checked by scripts/vm-security-check.sh (T-424). Measured with 'vm-security-check.sh measure' on a booted image. A looser value needs a reason in the same commit.

ruya-grub-menu.service.reason: root oneshot that writes the GRUB custom.cfg on /boot; measured 0.0.61

ruya-inputd.service.reason: own user ruya-input, no caps, no IP; reads /dev/input, uinput; no PrivateNetwork (the udev monitor, 06-input.md section 3); measured 0.0.69-input (RUY-3)

ruya-library.service.reason: own user, no caps, no network; measured 0.0.61

ruya-session.service.reason: root, empty capability set, no network, 01-platform.md section 3 (T-162); measured 0.0.61
